caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object placed on a flat, rectangular base. The base appears solid, with a slightly raised edge on one side and a small bracket projecting from the bottom front edge. From the base rises an upright, twisted rod that forms the main vertical support. Attached to this rod are a curved arm on the left, which has decorative spiral elements, and a second arm on the right, which rises upward before curling downward in a hook shape. At the top of the structure, on the right, there is a conical holder, possibly meant for containing a small object. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of gray on a light tan or beige background, created with pencil or charcoal, giving the metal object a realistic texture and sense of depth. The artist's signature, "Filippo Anceca," is visible in the bottom left corner. There is also a small, irregular orange mark in the upper left corner of the paper.
title: Rush Light and Candle Holder
